title: Text Formatting and Typography
description: Learn how to style and format text using HTML tags.

flashcards.question: Which tag is used to make text bold?
How do you italicize text in HTML?
Which tags are used for superscript and subscript?
How do you add a block quotation?
What tag is used to define inline quotes?
What is the difference between <strong> and <b>?
flashcards.answer: <strong> indicates importance (semantic), while <b> is just stylistic bold.
